title: Learning Methods
blurb: Supervised, unsupervised, self-supervised, reinforcement — and their relatives.
source: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) exam guide · Domain 1
hint: To identify the method, ask where its learning signal comes from: supplied answers, hidden structure in raw data, labels created from the data itself, or rewards from interaction.
